title: Heisenberg scaling under collective non-parallel directional noise via geometric state design
summary: Spin-squeezed states enable entanglement-enhanced frequency estimation; however, the achievable performance is limited in practice by decoherence. We study the problem of parameter estimation under \emph{classical collective noise} that acts along a \emph{fixed} direction during signal encoding. While we restrict our analysis to Gaussian noise statistics, no assumption is made on the nature of the noise temporal correlations.
